stem: A learner wants to begin hemp production at a new U.S. location. What is the strongest first regulatory step?
choices: Identify whether the location is governed by a state, tribal or USDA hemp program and check the current official requirements
Assume a license from another location transfers automatically
Use an old forum post as authorization
Treat an Academy certificate as a production license
rationale: USDA directs growers to determine the applicable program based on the production location and obtain the required authorization.
